mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_subscriptions ( user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, user_agent ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{endpoint}, #{p256dh}, #{auth}, #{userAgent} ) ON CONFLICT (endpoint) DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id, p256dh = EXCLUDED.p256dh, auth = EXCLUDED.auth, user_agent = EXCLUDED.user_agent, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT endpoint, p256dh, auth FROM push_subscriptions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
